programs.title: The McBee Dynasty: Real American Cowboys
programs.desc: McBee Farm & Cattle is on the verge of becoming a billion-dollar business, with its success hinging on a venture capital deal worth over a hundred million dollars; Steve's four sons vie to take over the farming dynasty.

programs.title: The McBee Dynasty: Real American Cowboys
programs.desc: With a hundred-million-dollar deal in CFO Galyna's hands, Steve must make sure that his love triangle between her and another woman, Brooke, doesn't threaten it all; Steven Jr. and Cole's competition to run the farm heats up.

programs.title: The McBee Dynasty: Real American Cowboys
programs.desc: Galyna's discovery that Steve is having an affair with Brooke could mean the end of the farm; Cole returns from Fort Worth, Texas, and hides his indiscretions from Kacie; Calah refuses to care about Steve's opinion of her.

programs.title: The McBee Dynasty: Real American Cowboys
programs.desc: With the future of the farm at stake, Galyna issues Steve an ultimatum, and he must decide between Brooke and keeping Galyna as his CFO; the crops are threatened by a relentless drought, and the family faces haters at a local car race.

programs.title: The McBee Dynasty: Real American Cowboys
programs.desc: When the McBees travel to Montana to pick up bison, they connect to the land with their Indigenous American hosts; back in Missouri, the girlfriends bond over their frustrations with Steve; Cole must decide to make it official with Kacie or lose her.

programs.title: The McBee Dynasty: Real American Cowboys
programs.desc: Galyna uses her leverage on the pending venture capital deal to move into Steve's house permanently, alarming his sons about her power within the company; Jesse and Cole confront Steven Jr. over their wage disparity.
